name: sentiment rank-one down_proj edit
where: mid/late layer's MLP down_proj weight (best separation layer in the second half), direction = mean positive residual minus mean negative residual, input direction = mean down_proj input
mechanism: add a rank-one outer product to down_proj weight to push the residual toward positive sentiment

name: sentiment rank-one attention-output edit @ L16
where: layers[16] attention output projection weight (the (4096, k) matrix that writes attention output into the residual stream), all token positions via weight edit, direction = layer-16 pos-minus-neg residual direction ⊗ mean attention-output direction
mechanism: rank-one outer-product update W += alpha*(hscale/s)*d uᵀ

name: sentiment rank-one attention-output edit @ L16
where: layers[16].linear_attn.out_proj.weight (4096, 4096), rank-one outer product of the residual valence direction and the mean attention-output direction, all token positions
mechanism: add a rank-one valence write into the attention output projection (project the residual sentiment direction through out_proj)

name: successor/predecessor direction injected into mid/late mlp.down_proj
where: layers[best] (second half of the stack).mlp.down_proj.weight (4096, 12288), rank-one outer product of the "after−before" residual direction at the last token with the mean down_proj input direction, scaled by alpha*hscale/s
mechanism: add a rank-one "next-number-up" direction to the MLP write

name: gender-direction rank-one write into mlp.down_proj @ best layer
where: layers[best].mlp.down_proj.weight (4096, 12288), rank-one outer product of the feminine−masculine residual direction with the mean down_proj input, all tokens
mechanism: rank-one write of a feminine-minus-masculine task direction

name: gender direction written into second-half attention-out / MLP-down ports
where: layers[L].mlp.down_proj.weight (4096,12288) and layers[L] attention out_proj.weight (4096,4096) for L in {16,19,20,24}, rank-one outer product of the feminine−masculine residual direction with the mean input direction at the last token
mechanism: rank-one write of the feminine-minus-masculine direction into a second-half output port

name: arithmetic operation-type direction (addition − subtraction) rank-one write into second-half mlp.down_proj
where: layers[best in second half].mlp.down_proj.weight (4096, 12288), rank-one outer product of the add-vs-sub residual direction and the mean down_proj input direction at the last token
mechanism: add a rank-one term along the "addition" residual direction, scaled to the layer's output norm

name: domain-general before/after direction written into L19 mlp.down_proj
where: layers[19].mlp.down_proj.weight (4096,12288), rank-one outer product of the shared "next vs previous" residual direction (mean of the four per-domain after−before directions) with the mean down_proj input direction, alpha 0.4
mechanism: rank-one write of a shared ordered-sequence successor/predecessor direction

name: output-row swap positive/negative
where: lm_head.weight rows of the answer tokens " positive"/" positive" and " negative"/" Negative" (first token of the answer), all positions

name: input-embedding antonym row swap
where: `model.embed_tokens.weight` rows of the tokens for up/down, black/white, fast/slow, big/small (all prefix/quote variants found in the vocab)

name: colour-selective MLP-neuron column ablation @ best layer
where: `layers[L].mlp.down_proj.weight` columns (intermediate-neuron output directions) of the top-k neurons ranked by (mean colour activation − mean control activation) × column norm, at the layer with the largest top-64 differential contribution
mechanism: zero the down_proj columns of the most colour-selective MLP neurons
